Custom bullet character for unordered lists

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"bullets\":\"*\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<ul><li>Item A</li><li>Item B</li></ul>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
